methods.title: The Elephant in the Room: Towards A Reliable Time-Series Anomaly Detection Benchmark
methods.mechanism_delta: 1070-series benchmark with consistent algorithms, data and metrics; recommends VUS-PR and exposes flawed protocols
methods.dor_impact: retain simple baselines, prohibit cherry-picked metrics and add event/range-aware evaluation before deployment claims
risks: benchmark aggregation does not identify one universally best detector

methods.title: UniTS: A Unified Multi-Task Time Series Model
methods.mechanism_delta: task tokenization and a shared sequence model across multiple time-series tasks
methods.dor_impact: only admit behind modality, compute and cross-domain validation gates; never replace low-complexity baselines by default
risks: general time-series benchmarks are not industrial-device field validation
larger inference cost

methods.title: PATH: A Discrete-sequence Dataset for Evaluating Online Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Approaches
methods.mechanism_delta: physically inspired discrete multivariate powertrain sequences with clean and contaminated folds
methods.dor_impact: add contamination, variable-state and threshold-sensitivity audits
risks: simulated powertrain evidence is not field evidence

methods.title: First-Shot Unsupervised Anomalous Sound Detection for Machine Condition Monitoring
methods.mechanism_delta: first-shot evaluation on new machine types under source/target-domain shift and noisy factory backgrounds
methods.dor_impact: raw-audio adapter and domain-held-out gate are required before claiming modality coverage
risks: anomaly score does not localize a physical component

methods.title: UniFault: A Fault Diagnosis Foundation Model from Bearing Data
methods.mechanism_delta: bearing-data harmonization plus cross-domain temporal fusion pretraining
methods.dor_impact: a possible future encoder candidate only after independent specimen-held-out and resource-matched reproduction
risks: bearing-centric corpus
preprint self-report
harmonization may discard channel semantics

methods.title: Mantis: Lightweight Calibrated Foundation Model for User-Friendly Time Series Classification
methods.mechanism_delta: contrastive vision-transformer time-series pretraining with multivariate adapters and calibration
methods.dor_impact: compare only under identical train data, parameter/model-size and latency budgets
risks: workshop evidence
classification focus does not cover causal diagnosis

methods.title: Contaminated Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection with Spatio-Temporal Graph Conditional Diffusion Models
methods.mechanism_delta: training-set decontamination followed by spatiotemporal graph conditional diffusion scoring
methods.dor_impact: normal-only trust must be audited; contaminated-training benchmark becomes a qualification gate
risks: diffusion compute cost
decontamination errors can remove rare normal regimes

methods.title: M2-STGN: A Missing Data-Tolerant Learning Model for Condition Monitoring of Wind Turbines
methods.venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
methods.mechanism_delta: multiscale graph attention, masked temporal attention and temporal convolution for incomplete SCADA
methods.dor_impact: missing-sensor stress and fallback behavior are now part of candidate admission
risks: two wind datasets do not prove cross-device universality
complexity must be resource matched

methods.title: Unsupervised Anomalous Sound Detection in Industrial Machine Facilities
methods.mechanism_delta: autoencoder representations plus Gaussian mixture scoring under high noise and reverberation
methods.dor_impact: audio support must include simple AE/GMM-like baselines and explicit SNR slices
risks: venue experiment scope may be site-specific

methods.title: FactoryNet: A Large-Scale Dataset toward Industrial Time-Series Foundation Models
methods.mechanism_delta: Setpoint-Effort-Feedback-Context schema across real, simulated and counterfactual manufacturing episodes
methods.dor_impact: supports future cross-embodiment stress tests, but license and independent review gates remain open
risks: preprint
license absent from verified card
synthetic counterfactuals are not observed failures

methods.title: Exploring Zero-Shot Foundation Models for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
methods.mechanism_delta: tests naive forecasting and embedding routes on SWaT and reports anomaly overgeneralization/boundary bias
methods.dor_impact: foundation models cannot enter the default registry from reputation or zero-shot claims alone
risks: single industrial-control benchmark
preprint

methods.title: Adaptive Conformal Anomaly Detection with Time Series Foundation Models for Signal Monitoring
methods.mechanism_delta: weighted adaptive quantiles and false-alarm p-values around foundation-model outputs
methods.dor_impact: motivates adaptive calibration experiments but does not replace held-out deployment validation
risks: preprint self-report
coverage assumptions can fail under arbitrary shift

methods.title: SymMatika: Structure-Aware Symbolic Discovery
methods.mechanism_delta: multi-island genetic programming with feedback-driven operator scheduling and reusable expression-subtree motifs
methods.dor_impact: route qualified explicit or implicit mechanism gaps to the existing ISGN/M2N external adapter and require independent industrial validation before admission
risks: preprint self-report
27 of 100 Feynman tasks remain unsolved
noise robustness and high-dimensional implicit recovery remain open
large CPU search cost

methods.title: From Physics to Machine Learning and Back: Part II - Learning and Observational Bias in PHM
methods.mechanism_delta: organizes learning and observational physics biases, virtual sensing, multimodal fusion, fleet transfer and decision-making boundaries for PHM
methods.dor_impact: make bias route, virtual-sensor lineage, sim-to-real, domain generalization and missing-modality qualification explicit control-plane concerns
risks: review evidence is not a component benchmark
physics constraints can be wrong or non-identifiable
simulation evidence is not field evidence

methods.title: The Neural Compiler: Program-to-Network Translation for Hybrid Scientific Machine Learning
methods.mechanism_delta: compiles a restricted arithmetic program into a frozen differentiable module that composes with learned residuals
methods.dor_impact: add an allowlisted symbolic-expression compiler and solver-aware hybrid runtime while preserving domain guards and physical-truth disclaimers
risks: preprint self-report
program structure must already be known
hybrid credit assignment may be non-unique
singular and periodic parameter landscapes can defeat gradient fitting

methods.title: Conformal Fusion Under Missing Modalities
methods.mechanism_delta: vacuous evidence for absent modalities, evidential opinion fusion and Mondrian conformal calibration keyed by modality-presence mask
methods.dor_impact: retain FEC mask-conditional calibration, fail closed for sparse/unseen masks and report held-out coverage and prediction-set efficiency by mask
risks: preprint self-report
2^M-1 mask growth
exchangeability is required within each mask
single-label experiments do not establish multilabel validity

methods.title: Perceptual Flow Matching for Few-Step Generative Modeling
methods.mechanism_delta: moves flow-matching supervision from latent Euclidean velocity error to pretrained perceptual feature space
methods.dor_impact: do not add to the industrial diagnostic model registry without a physics-consistent time-series generation problem and leakage-safe validation
risks: work in progress
vision-only evidence
perceptual geometry may not preserve diagnostic mechanisms
synthetic faults may be plausible-looking but physically false
